selection_issue: All 12 selected questions were high-uncertainty, retrieval-hard cases and all used hybrid_bge. The feasibility pilot therefore does not compare risk strata or agent routes.
graph_generation_issue: Text-only and graph-assisted final answer strings were identical for all 12 of 12 questions. The current pilot does not demonstrate that graph reasoning changed answer generation.
verifier_independence_issue: The same Groq model family generated and verified the claims. Independent manual labels and preferably a distinct verifier model are required.
